claims.text: 10 U.S.C. 101(a)(16) defines the different term 'congressional defense committees' as only '(A) the Committee on Armed Services and the Committee on Appropriations of the Senate; and (B) the Committee on Armed Services and the Committee on Appropriations of the House of Representatives' - four bodies, not the six used by section 119.

topics.title: Who gets told: 10 U.S.C. 119, the Gang of Eight and the waived-SAP notification group
